title: Club

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Club is the first one-handed club. Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Unlike other one-handed clubs, it has no secondary attack.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Not very effective at quality 1, as a Flint axe may be preferred. The Club becomes much stronger with upgrades, especially against Skeletons, which take 50% more damage from blunt.

Introduction. The Club is the first one-handed club. Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Unlike other one-handed clubs, it has no secondary attack.

Notes. • Not very effective at quality 1, as a Flint axe may be preferred. The Club becomes much stronger with upgrades, especially against Skeletons, which take 50% more damage from blunt.
